highlights.title: Tesla and SpaceX take first step towards merger, would dilute all shareholders
highlights.description: Tesla and SpaceX have both formed special committees within their corporate boards to explore the possibility of merging the two companies according to Elon Musk, who is CEO of both companies. The merger could have big consequences not just for Tesla and SpaceX shareholders, but could dilute the retirement savings of everyone with exposure to major stock indices. more…

highlights.title: SpaceX-Tesla Combination ‘Extremely Tangible,’ Ferragu Says
highlights.description: Pierre Ferragu, managing director at New Street Research, examines the prospect of combining SpaceX with Tesla Inc. Elon Musk openly endorsed the idea Tuesday, saying the boards of both companies had formed special committees of independent directors to consider the proposal. He speaks on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

devices.title: The iPhone Duo is a messy, expensive, good time
devices.description: The iPhone Duo is the riskiest Apple product in years. It's a huge rethink of what an iPhone is and could be, and it contains the seeds of many fascinating ideas that might be great in the future. But that future is yet to come. The iPhone Duo is also one of Apple's messiest first-generation products in a long time, and right now it will delight gadget nerds and early adopters and likely frustrate everyone else. It's been a minute since the iPhone has looked or worked significantly differently.
